text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a part of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. One important area is text understanding, which allows machines to find meaning in written words. NLP is also used for translation, so people can read texts in different languages more easily. Another useful application is sentiment analysis, which helps companies discover whether customers feel positive or negative about a product. Finally, chatbots use NLP to communicate with people in a natural way. They can answer questions and give support at any time. Thanks to NLP, our daily life with technology is becoming simpler and more comfortable.
